author: micka1
text:
salivan wrote: what is your most interesting quote ?

mine :

“Here’s to the crazy ones, the misfits, the rebels, the troublemakers,
the round pegs in the square holes… The ones who see things differently —
 they’re not fond of rules… You can quote them, disagree with them,
glorify or vilify them, but the only thing you can’t do is ignore them
because they change things… They push the human race forward, and while
some may see them as the crazy ones, we see genius, because the ones who
 are crazy enough to think that they can change the world, are the ones
who do.”

Steve Jobs

what about yours ?

There's so many... As far as motivational ones go , i like this one:

"Never lose hope, be persistent and stubborn and never give up. There
are many instances in history where apparent losers suddenly turn out to
 be winners unexpectedly, so you should never conclude all hope is
lost."

Theodore John Kaczynski, Ph.D

That being said...(motivation aside)...I like these types of quotes:

"Government is the great fiction, through which everybody endeavors to live at the expense of everybody else."

Frederic Bastiat

"An appeaser is one who feeds a crocodile, hoping it will eat him last. "

Winston Churchill

"the chief cause of problems is solutions"

Eric Sevareid

"Only the winners decide what were war crimes"

(Gary Wills)

"If pigs could vote, the man with the slop bucket would be elected
swineherd every time, no matter how much slaughtering he did on the
side."

- Orson Scott Card

“Courage is almost a contradiction in terms. It means a strong desire to live taking the form of a readiness to die.”

~ G.K. Chesterton

"The players and the pieces… Every man’s a piece to start with, and every maid as well. Even some who think they are players."

Petyr Baelish”

- (George R.R. Martin, A Storm of Swords)

"Love is blind; friendship closes its eyes."

Friedrich Nietzsche

"Tolerance is a proof of distrust in one’s own ideals." -

Friedrich Nietzsche

"We often contradict an opinion for no other reason than that we do not like the tone in which it is expressed"

Human All Too Human, Man in Society, Aphorism 303 (1878)

Nietzsche

"He that humbleth himself wishes to be exalted"

Friedrich Nietzsche

"The opportunity to secure ourselves against defeat lies in our own
hands, but the opportunity of defeating the enemy is provided by the
enemy himself."

Sun Tzu

author: franc464

awesome trading!! Really inspiring...

author: salivan
text:
Hiya hndrk

i always set my target (still learning yet, assume i was shorting) in
those places that i am ready for buy , it depends all the time , where
your entry is good the target is always clear (trading the extremes)

in this case in your chart price always goes from FL to FL , and if that
 FTR is my interesting FL then yes , that 's the target .

we look for OPP in HTF then we enter in LTF and we look for target in HTF then we set it in LTF.

hope it helps you

regards

Salivan
